run_controlnet_inpaint_pipeline: run StableDiffusionControlNetInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image using a prompt, mask, and ControlNet control image
encode_prompt_with_clip: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method with optional LoRA scaling
prepare_latents_for_inpainting: prepare latent variables for inpainting by encoding an image and adding noise based on strength
prepare_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked-image latents by resizing the mask and encoding the masked image through the VAE
prepare_control_image: preprocess and resize a control image for ControlNet conditioning with optional classifier-free guidance duplication
